description: Source code implementing socket BIO (Basic I/O) functions for OpenSSL, including socket read, write, control, and creation functions.

methods.name: sock_free
methods.description: Frees socket resources, closes socket if shutdown flag is set.

methods.name: sock_read
methods.description: Reads data from socket, handles retries.

methods.name: sock_write
methods.description: Writes data to socket, handles retries.

methods.name: sock_ctrl
methods.description: Controls socket BIO parameters like file descriptor and shutdown behavior.
